Attend Our Events Explore The Collection Composed of more than 15 million items that span centuries, the state's collection encompasses the rich and diverse history of the people of Colorado. Learn More Preservation & Archaeology History Colorado’s preservation programs are the most significant forces behind protecting historic places across all 64 Colorado counties. These programs restore and give fresh purpose to old places while infusing energy into urban, rural, and mountain communities. Learn More Grant Funding Opportunities Office of State Archaeologist (OSAC) Programs to preserve and protect Colorado's archaeological, paleontological, and historic resources, as well as the administration related state and federal laws. State Historical Fund (SHF) Grants to identify, preserve and restore significant sites, structures, and districts for education and cultural experiences. Review & Compliance Resources on how to engage about historic places that may be impacted by state or federal projects or funds. Tax Credits Information on how to access funds to restore and rehabilitate historic places, including for commercial uses and affordable housing. Access Compass A database that supports archaeological research, preservation programs, geographic mapping, and cultural resource management.
